notes.title: One Year of Early Access... and a Fresh Start for QANGA
notes.notes:
[p]In September 2024, QANGA took its very first steps into Early Access. One year later, the adventure continues, and we wanted to take a moment to look back at the journey we’ve shared so far.[/p][p]With 21 updates in total, including 16 major ones, the game has changed dramatically. Today’s QANGA looks very different from what it was back in 2024. But this is just the beginning, and the months ahead will bring even more changes.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]What We’ve Accomplished So Far[/h2][p]Since its Early Access launch, QANGA has grown in many ways. The construction mode, which started out as an experimental feature, has received major improvements and now offers far more possibilities than it did at the start. Overall performance has also been significantly optimized. While this remains an ongoing process, QANGA is now much more stable and playable on a wide range of hardware.[/p][p]Content-wise, there’s been plenty of evolution as well. HOTAS support has boosted piloting immersion, while new types of Sanglines and their spawners have increased the variety of threats to face. The interface has been gradually reworked, especially inside cockpits, for greater clarity and realism. Weapons have expanded too, with new ranged and melee options, plus the ability to equip vehicles for combat. Along the same lines, both spaceflight and ground vehicle handling have been extensively overhauled for a smoother, more enjoyable experience.[/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/e06d0e83dda10897f8c957d34aa5042894b39123.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/2d51c1a038ea81a8260e92e828b488cb218ce186.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/f78a26a79c4b6da362c354880a4c85105d64438e.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/9cd8f4bf6e24ce4eee8a453d50f424b17ed9f4f9.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][p]And that’s not all. Resource mining has made its debut, new locations keep being added on Earth and in space, and the AI has improved with better pathfinding and richer location generation. The police are now present in-game, with their system nearly complete, marking an important milestone in the evolution of QANGA’s world.[/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/460fc18bc67b18afeb71b9371df125baaabfadd5.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/d614b401812338688f485c572489a42c8d0014c5.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/25bcfcd7fdb67a3e514eb6197dabcf30558bb3bd.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/b7001aef9bdda6bd7169411722edb115e963baf6.png"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][p]All of this has been achieved in just one year by a very small team. It’s something we’re proud of and a huge motivation to keep pushing forward.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]What’s Next[/h2][p]The universe is still being built, and some major transformations are on the way.[/p][p]For the past few months, the team has been working on a brand-new internal mission creation tool. This tool is a game changer. It will allow us to create deeper, richer quests, and to do so more efficiently and quickly. This is a key step toward the future of QANGA.[/p][p]Its first real application will be a complete overhaul of the tutorial. Until now, the tutorial only lasted a few minutes and explained the basics of gameplay, such as Matter, recycling, inventory, and the jetpack, far too briefly. With this revamp, the experience will be fully reimagined: more organic, more immersive, and more narrative-driven. Players will be dropped straight into the action and the world of QANGA, with clearer explanations guiding them right from the start, just like a proper tutorial should.[/p][p]This fresh start will also be the moment to introduce Tona, one of the central characters in QANGA’s lore, who will make their first appearance and guide the Cyborgs through their first steps.[/p][p]The first stages of these changes can already be seen in Djibouti. A new building has been erected to house this new tutorial, as well as an entire city.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/f4a83b269246d99961c0321c375c426bf23ab255.png"][/img][/p][p]And this is only the beginning. In the coming months, QANGA will continue to evolve with a broader rework of missions and new ways to progress through its universe.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Thank You[/h2][p]This anniversary is the perfect time to say that none of this progress would have been possible without you. Your feedback, testing, and support have kept us motivated at every step of development.[/p][p]QANGA’s journey is only just beginning, and we can’t wait to show you what’s next.[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: QANGA Update - Patch Notes v0.0.17
notes.notes: [p]Hey Cyborgs![/p][p]A brand new QANGA update is here! 🎉[/p][p]This version brings a lot of new content: a new city, a brand new starting point for Cyborgs, two new ships, police units already deployed in the game, and more than 60 new construction pieces. Among other things.[/p][p]We decided to split this update into two phases. The new police system, which was originally planned to be part of this release, will arrive a bit later so we can fine-tune it to meet our expectations. In the meantime, you can already encounter police units in the world and see them in action.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]What's New[/h2][p][/p][h3]Awakening Center[/h3][p]A brand new building now stands near the Relay Tower: the [b]Awakening Center[/b].[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/664b2fd9116133cd49bbf4bd1297c47db15d7cf2.png"][/img][/p][p]This is where new Cyborgs will begin their journey. The tutorial mission is not available yet but is already well advanced. It will be added in a future update and will allow you to:[/p][list][*][p]Discover your new body and your first upgrade modules[/p][/*][*][p]Activate your drone and learn how to use it[/p][/*][*][p]Meet [b]Tona[/b], one of the key characters in the story[/p][/*][/list][p]This setup lays the groundwork for a much more narrative and immersive introduction.[/p][p]But for now, you can already visit the building that will host this new introduction.[/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/9d7ff7a9f0220313a91f47a70e856b7ca5ed2a22.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/eddec0fb0d56da576af3bd218cbf2dac40ec470c.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/5878ae37f37514494928a60dd30f3d26585a4808.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/16ed1aa72d708ab0aa77f01f6734b57c73efa60e.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/bb213becb5deecf6cd9947cbd07fa1ef25a85fdf.png"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][p][/p][h3]Djibouti City[/h3][p]Not far from this same Relay Tower, a new city has just emerged. Djibouti City will be the true starting point of the adventure for new Cyborgs.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/f308fb6c8befad9264023cd76701ac612a77837f.png"][/img][/p][p]We are still working on the overall atmosphere, but our goal is to make it a village protected from the Sanglines by the police, a safe place where players can rest, trade, and prepare before heading out on missions, with everything you would expect from such a place: shops, medical center, armory, delivery points, and more.[/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/9c8417bd927540172ced868b8f7ec21820351f78.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/425cf985ef40a6cbf50242fa7608fc7674fb71c3.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/6520e6cf2391e02cacfe5ee66276c4d3177f6af7.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/1638cdbc5de43d9488284de3ba9cdee4a555baa2.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/0920968c8e2f7f739bb1edac6ec8548c6ca4fc91.png"][/img][/carousel][p]With the mission system currently in development, Djibouti City will gradually become the heart of progression and new quests. This new system will significantly transform the overall experience in the coming months.[/p][p]How about a quick guided tour?[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="-aZEhvdCu0A;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3]New Ships and Vehicles[/h3][p]Two new ships are arriving:[/p][list][*][p][b]Lavrik[/b], with its police variant[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/b7001aef9bdda6bd7169411722edb115e963baf6.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]Orizaune[/b], a lighter and more agile model[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/cd9579e8d2180255c3a8662aa704ec71ee4eecec.png"][/img][/p][p]On the ground side, the [b]Melrose[/b] car also gets its police variant.[/p][p][/p][h3]First Deployed Police Units[/h3][p]Even though the full police system is not active yet, you can already encounter and interact with the new units:[/p][list][*][p]Police Cyborgs[/p][/*][*][p]Autonomous units[/p][/*][*][p]Drones[/p][/*][*][p]Patrol ships[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/d614b401812338688f485c572489a42c8d0014c5.png"][/img][/p][p]You can even get inside police vehicles, turn on the lights and blast the sirens! We will share more details about the full police system (and wanted levels) in an upcoming post.[/p][p][/p][h3]Construction - New IronDee Collection[/h3][p]A huge addition for construction with more than 60 new pieces![/p][p]A brand new collection, IronDee, is now available alongside the existing ICLabs collection. Perfect for creating even more unique and stylish bases.[/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/b9135ac5a37df447ea33be5930f3e3dc4383606f.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/9a0fa825516306266c7f903527eb208106e0cde1.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/2e533fa58c3e7cb21312b82bd983954e9556263b.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/fe761e24ac525f7642bd669a81e7ba9fdacd76d1.png"][/img][/carousel][p]We also took the opportunity to add the "Zoop" mode, a system that lets you place several elements in a row with a single action, perfect for building a wall or aligning several floors quickly. You can select the mode with the default "G" key, with three options:[/p][list][*][p]Single (one piece placed)[/p][/*][*][p]H Zoop (horizontal Zoop)[/p][/*][*][p]V Zoop (vertical Zoop)[/p][/*][/list][previewyoutube="vN4SmY2VhDg;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3]Radios[/h3][p]Fixed radios have been placed in the world, for now in Finistère and Djibouti City. notes.title: Coming soon to QANGA: police, ships, and new horizons
notes.notes:
[p]Coming soon to QANGA: police, ships, and new horizons[/p][p]It’s still summer. The heat is on. But that doesn’t mean we’re slowing down on QANGA, quite the opposite! The team is working hard (with plenty of fans running!) and we’re excited to share the first details on upcoming content.[/p][p][/p][p]  
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Police system[/b][/h2][p]This is the biggest feature coming up.[/p][p]The police system has been completely reworked (it was introduced at the beginning of Early Access, then removed), with mechanics inspired by certain games and based on a star system. The more crimes you commit, the more intense the police response will become: drones, automatons, ships, and law enforcement ready to hunt you down.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/d614b401812338688f485c572489a42c8d0014c5.png"][/img][/p][p]We’ll share more in a dedicated article, but get ready to see your behavior truly impact the world of QANGA.[/p][p][/p][p]  
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]New ships[/b][/h2][p]You’ll soon be able to add two new ships to your fleet.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Lavrik[/b]: The official law enforcement ship. Solid, intimidating, and formidable, it was designed to command respect. But here’s the good news: a civilian, pilotable version will also be available for you, Cyborgs.[/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/b7001aef9bdda6bd7169411722edb115e963baf6.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/eac7ef1e9977c56a63f83302fd575033b63ef293.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/58619bf4a4867bd524785d9c143d8606b4c44edc.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/7478acd82ebd98889066a4c791f7d1ae24cb5354.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/c327c04bae41d3e9d186018461bc692ee547ccf1.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/3a77923e3907d00cde9fcae9dde326bfb9fc93c1.png"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][p][b]Orizaune[/b]: This one was built for speed and competition. A racing ship that combines style and maneuverability while still being armed. Customizable, it’s made for the circuits we plan to introduce in the future.[/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/7e0a217d93cf72a06cbe0545ba0a921f34ad9c15.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/cd9579e8d2180255c3a8662aa704ec71ee4eecec.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/1909a7fdf417fa2306edeaae90b4d4e58cc478ee.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/25bcfcd7fdb67a3e514eb6197dabcf30558bb3bd.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/17a1f787243ad7e8795fbd030202b97bfeb92b03.png"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][p]You’ll learn more about their design in a dedicated article coming soon.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Djibouti City[/b][/h2][p]A new location is appearing: Djibouti City, located right next to the Djibouti Relay Tower, the arrival point of your Cyborg at the start of the game. Under the control of ICLabs Industries, this cosmopolitan city brings together human survivors and Cyborgs, forming a fragile balance between tradition and technology. In its streets, you’ll find settlers searching for a new chance alongside synthetics seeking stability.[/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/9c8417bd927540172ced868b8f7ec21820351f78.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/0920968c8e2f7f739bb1edac6ec8548c6ca4fc91.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/7fa1a6b351439b4f8fc09491bce439e08a6cbabc.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/425cf985ef40a6cbf50242fa7608fc7674fb71c3.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/6520e6cf2391e02cacfe5ee66276c4d3177f6af7.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/460fc18bc67b18afeb71b9371df125baaabfadd5.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/f3c0a86a6e5020cd4beaa3dfbdff20e4240b9db4.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/68d80e9a77b78f716bd26daf46fa31d4aeb3689c.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/1638cdbc5de43d9488284de3ba9cdee4a555baa2.png"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][p]But the shadow of the Sanglines lingers: police patrols constantly circle the city to contain the threat and preserve this enclave of relative safety. Djibouti City thus becomes a new environment to explore, but also the first stronghold where your adventures will unfold.[/p][p]Close to the Relay Tower now stands a brand-new building: the [b]Awakening Center[/b]. The true heart of the Cyborg program, this complex marks the end of the production chain, where cryogenized human minds are synchronized with their synthetic bodies. It’s here that every Cyborg opens their eyes for the very first time, before stepping into an unstable and dangerous world. The first step of a long journey, this place seals the bond between technology and survival, serving as the starting point for every Cyborg’s (reworked) story.[/p][p][i]This is a WIP, not final at all. But you can see on the carousel the building in its current form and some work documents.[/i][/p][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/11e9dfeae49f4d7bddc73b89b3d203b22959034e.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/a95c853224bb1ab69fb09bcca2b6546676bc5282.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/993e1c68154324bba472f12fa1426f3b7c365235.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/99adc682fc5796bdabefbc0e549f80b008317c35.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/3cbbd1008137c1c75ce7257cde1401f317f9114b.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/761d925db4d0cf4e842e9bf468f3129c78e111ec.png"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Visual revamp for trams[/b][/h2][p]The trams have received a visual refresh, with new colors breaking away from their old, dull appearance. More contrasted, they now bring greater life and character to the Relay Towers they serve.[/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/fa5b585abd1fede43dbf09b3f3f925ba411b2a0c.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/c9e8bd43c6b5e15f9655705c4d37b2d4557d7204.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/c7d4ac0c7a2ce121b380176c31886208d3d42f6b.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/68e696674913161b5f3c0264a8c1e24b3bc7da54.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/6c0035beab42d639d8da79a48e863ce4247f4889.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/886a8f9946bffab414825b2fb5edb2b54be034e7.png"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png"][/img][/p][p] [/p][h2][b]PvP events[/b][/h2][p]Alongside the new features already available, the team is also working on dynamic PvP events to spice up the experience. One concept in development involves an isolated production plant where valuable shipments are stored. Players will need to infiltrate the facility, retrieve the goods, and attempt to extract them under high pressure.[/p][p]The real challenge will lie in deciding whether to cooperate to secure the extraction or betray others to claim the loot. These events are designed as true tests of skill, strategy, and survival, where every decision can turn a successful operation into total disaster.[/p][p]These are early design ideas. The final result will surely evolve during development.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png"][/img][/p][p]  
[/p][h2][b]Vehicle damage[/b][/h2][p]The team has also started working on a visual damage system. Your vehicle won’t just be a means of transportation anymore: it will now bear the marks of your battles. Scratches, impact marks, damaged parts… all details that will enhance immersion and add realism to your explorations.[/p][p]This is still a work in progress and will continue to evolve during development.[/p][previewyoutube="Rj_LxQ8dwjc;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]  
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]For now, most of this content is being tested on our pre-live server, accessible to our Sentinels.[/p][p]Don’t forget that you can also support the game’s development through [url="https://www.patreon.com/c/qanga"]our Patreon page[/url] (and gain access to the pre-live server at certain tiers). Since the beginning of the QANGA adventure, our goal has been to build a genuine, authentic relationship with the community. Beyond the financial aspect, Patreon is also a way to strengthen that bond. Feel free to check it out and support us if you can.[/p][p]And of course, we’re always around on our [url="https://discord.com/invite/qanga"]Discord server[/url]. Come say hi![/p]

notes.title: Ground vehicles get a makeover
notes.notes: [p]QANGA's ground vehicles have never had wheels. They hover just above the surface thanks to a magnetic suspension system – Hovercrafts. A sleek technology, but one that still needed to be tamed.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/cbab59be7ccc882c80da54c3446d8b71395f8979.png"][/img] [/p][p]Until now, driving across rough terrain could quickly become unpredictable. A bad bump, a steep slope, and even a slight turn could send you spinning. That’s why we’ve completely reworked how these vehicles handle.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]In the upcoming update, you’ll experience much more stable driving. The physics engine has been improved: additional forces are now applied to keep the vehicle balanced – even when stationary, even with the engine off. It won’t slide down a hill on its own anymore, it won’t flip after a jump, and it maintains a logical posture even on sloped terrain.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="XZhhP-rJUTA;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]The acceleration phase has also been reworked. It’s smoother, more gradual. The vehicle builds up speed without jolts, moves forward more naturally. And when landing from a jump or a fall, it absorbs impacts better. The sense of control is immediate. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/b890a137aeb75cd35c5162e601d73903aded48f4.gif"][/img] [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]These adjustments also account for low-gravity environments. On the Moon, for example, the vehicle no longer bounces around awkwardly: it stays close to the ground while still preserving the light, floaty feeling unique to such areas.[/p][p][/p][p]And last but not least: momentum. If you exit the vehicle while it's moving, it will keep rolling for a while, driven by its own velocity. A small detail? Not really. It's the kind of behavior that brings machines to life and makes the experience more immersive.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/917ac9cb3ca3f117dd06c8d256995401ec51ff5a.gif"][/img] [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][i]All of this is coming very soon. We can’t wait to hear your thoughts once you're back behind the wheel.[/i][/p]

notes.title: A more vibrant solar system
notes.notes:
The past few weeks have been intense on the development front for our team, and we wanted to share some of the progress we’ve made with you.

As many of you already know, QANGA features a full-scale reproduction of the solar system, made possible in large part thanks to our internally developed plugin, Worldscape.

Recently, the team, especially CyberAlien, began a major overhaul of QANGA’s solar system structure, with one clear goal in mind: to make space more dense, more meaningful, and better suited for exploration and gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png[/img]

[h2]A denser, richer space[/h2]

Thanks to this deep rework, space between planets will no longer be just empty stretches to cross. QANGA’s solar system is gradually being filled with new spatial objects, distributed in a logical and realistic way:
[list]
[*]Space stations placed on specific orbits, potentially serving as relays, trading hubs, or refueling points.
[*]Moons orbiting certain planets, each following its own trajectory.
[*]Asteroid belts, particularly between Mars and Jupiter, bringing more opportunities for exploration, danger, and resource gathering.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png[/img]

[h2]Lagrange points[/h2]

To make all this work in a consistent way, CyberAlien also implemented a full system of Lagrange points. These well-known points in orbital mechanics represent areas of gravitational balance between two massive bodies, like a planet and its star or a planet and its moon.

In practical terms, these points are perfect for placing:
[list]
[*]Space stations, for refueling or fast travel
[*]Secondary orbits
[*]Groups of asteroids, like the famous Trojan asteroids that share Jupiter’s orbit in our real solar system
[/list]
You’ll find diagrams below, especially the one showing points L1 to L5 in a Sun/Planet system, to help visualize the placement logic we’re using.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png[/img]

[h2]What is a Lagrange point?[/h2]

A Lagrange point is a specific position in space where the gravitational pull of two massive bodies, like a star and a planet, balances with the centrifugal force experienced by a third object. In simple terms, these are locations where an object can remain stable or semi-stable without needing constant adjustments to its trajectory.

There are five such points for every pair of celestial bodies:
[list]
[*]L1, L2, and L3 lie along the line connecting the two bodies. They are useful but unstable.
[*]L4 and L5 form an equilateral triangle with the two bodies. These are the most stable points and are often naturally occupied by asteroids, like the Trojans near Jupiter.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/b0b68b26425eb10d45ed67eeb91db27fded1f6d1.png[/img]

This principle, applied in QANGA, allows us to place stations, moons, asteroid belts, and other space objects in a way that is both realistic and functional. It also opens up additional points of interest for players in the long run.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png[/img]

[h2]A glimpse behind the scenes[/h2]

Here are a few development screenshots from our internal tools, showing how the solar system structure is evolving. You will spot the addition of Lagrange points, orbital paths, and the gradual densification of interplanetary space.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/e8fd3264d8585abcc7bb38161bce05a1f0f9a3e5.png[/img]

[i]Solar System[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51fb7c76207a0927eca506b0ffd72e2fcfcefc9e.jpg[/img]

[i]Jupiter[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/6d499655a937d47c0eaf60acc04af927288f6c53.jpg[/img]

[i]Neptune[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/354fd2d0dc15117485ab08ae4fd438acb314bbc1.jpg[/img]

[i]NovaCeleste Station (green point) on the L5  point of Uranus[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/faa2e648e294d0fbcd3b283b341b432d3d1837b9.jpg[/img]

[i]Asteroid belt between Mars and Jupiter (red zone) with the stations (green points) Tycheko, Ceres, and Pallas[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/5716f0fcffb5ad3b8639afd076a4395106b616ef.jpg[/img]

[i]Talos Station (green point) around Saturn[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/4beadbda8da669707a2d96d43d1688d94d19cc05.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png[/img]

[h2]To infinity... and beyond?[/h2]

This solar system overhaul marks an important step toward a more vibrant and coherent universe. We are not just trying to fill space; we want it to have meaning, to support gameplay, exploration, and immersion.

Lagrange points and new orbital paths provide a solid technical foundation, but that does not mean each one will automatically host a station, a moon, or a point of interest. These are early steps, giving us the structure we need to imagine and design what comes next.

It’s still a work in progress, of course, but the foundations are in place. And we wanted to share a glimpse of what we’re building behind the scenes, because it’s clearly going to change the way we travel through... and experience... this universe.

More is coming soon.

notes.title: New threats are emerging
notes.notes:
You've been many to ask for more variety in enemy types — and that’s something we had clearly in mind for quite a while.

We started working on it back in late December, with an initial phase of concepts and brainstorming around new forms of Sanglines. Since then, these ideas have evolved, gone through a few internal tests (and plenty of sketches and back-and-forth), eventually giving birth to the three creatures you're about to discover today.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/3aa4c35f729d4b426858fada0b6faf3be3e1a99e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png[/img]

[h3]Gas Sac[/h3]

The Gas Sac floats peacefully through the air... until it spots you. The moment it does, it heads straight toward you and detonates on contact.

It’s not fast, nor subtle — you’ll spot it easily from above — but ignore it for too long and it can quickly become a serious threat.

Best take it out from a distance before it gets too close. A distracted Cyborg could quickly regret it. When it explodes, it releases a corrosive gas that can be fatal to your synthetic body.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/17b65d42735b99136d6186ae7cf8d967b1df2967.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png[/img]

[h3]Flyer[/h3]

As its name suggests, the Flyer prefers to attack from above.

It hovers at medium altitude, observes… then dives toward its target. It can also land to strike on the ground when the opportunity arises.

It shows no mercy: anything that moves is fair game, whether you're on foot or in a vehicle.

Sometimes alone, sometimes in a pack, it forces you to look up and stay mobile — especially in open areas.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/14809a6284a3be7fd60f459d6b18726d1a5bf323.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png[/img]

[h3]Sand Digger[/h3]

The Sand Digger is a sneaky one. You might see it coming from a distance, but the moment it feels threatened, it burrows — only to return by surprise.

It travels underground, then bursts out to attack with its powerful front limbs. Those aren’t just for offense — it also uses them defensively by shielding itself.

If you happen to be right above when it emerges, it can launch you into the air and leave you exposed.

It can appear almost anywhere, but in sandy regions, it’s clearly in its element.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/250bdb5fa134d72600185ebc74295a69c8840214.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png[/img]

[i]These three variants are just the beginning.

The world of QANGA is evolving — and so are the Sanglines. Other mutations are already being studied, some more aggressive, others… far more unpredictable.

Stay sharp, Cyborgs: the threat is just beginning.[/i]

notes.title: ICLabs Broadcast – Sangline Variants Confirmed
notes.notes:
[i]Excerpt from an official broadcast by ICLabs – Research Division

 Interview between journalist Ayla Romane (AR) and Dr. Emil Karrow (EK), biologist specializing in exo-environmental mutations at ICLabs.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png[/img]

[i]AR: Dr. Karrow, thank you for taking the time to speak with us. Can you confirm today the existence of new Sangline variants, such as the Sand Digger?[/i]
EK: Yes. The data collected from our orbital stations and field units is now consistent enough to confirm the existence of this entity. More importantly, these observations reinforce the idea that the Sanglines possess advanced adaptive behavior.

[i]AR: Adaptive? You mean they evolve?[/i]
EK: Not in the traditional Darwinian sense. What we’re witnessing is rapid, opportunistic morphological change, triggered by environmental conditions. These aren’t fixed species, but rather biological responses tailored to specific biomes—deserts, high altitudes, toxic atmospheres. Sanglines aren’t a single entity, but a dynamic evolutionary phenomenon, potentially without limits.

[i]AR: Let’s focus on the Sand Digger. What do we know about it so far?[/i]
EK: This creature has been identified in several desert zones with high geological instability. It remains undetectable until the moment it strikes—its thermal signature is nearly zero, except for brief spikes when it erupts from the ground. Morphologically, it resembles a hybrid of burrowing predator and invertebrate. It moves beneath the surface, likely by generating controlled vibrations and localized sand liquefaction. Its lower jaw is split and extensible, capable of snapping shut with significant force. It also has hooks or short limbs used to grab prey on impact.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/d24864f6aa46ff1f454be68bf0d005981f616138.png[/img]

[i]AR: Is it blind?[/i]
EK: Not exactly. Our analysis suggests it perceives mechanical vibrations through the ground, much like certain Earth species once did. Walking or running carelessly through its territory is the equivalent of ringing a bell.

[i]AR: Other variants have also been identified recently. What can you tell us about those?[/i]
EK: The Flyer, as its name suggests, is a winged variant capable of gliding or swooping down on targets from high altitudes. It has been observed in mountainous regions or near steep rock formations. Its skeleton is lightweight, and it demonstrates excellent aerial control. So far, it represents a direct threat to anything or anyone in open terrain.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/ca7f4bdfdd4113a5c4a318d6efabd0ba027d3984.jpg[/img]

The Gas Sac, on the other hand, is a bloated form—spherical or oval in shape—filled with unstable compounds. It floats slowly at low altitude and detonates when close to a target or upon impact. The explosion releases a toxic or acidic cloud, depending on the sample. It is often escorted by more aggressive variants that take advantage of the ensuing confusion.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/df3097050658bcb8357c8e079f5e27427cdf8af3.jpg[/img]

[i]AR: To conclude, what should we take away from these discoveries?[/i]
EK: That the Sanglines are not just surviving—they are spreading, adapting, and transforming. Every biome becomes an evolutionary testing ground. What we once thought was an isolated threat is now a global phenomenon. The variants we’ve already identified are likely just the beginning. If their logic of adaptation continues, then every corner of the planet—and beyond—could soon host its own horror.

[i]AR: Do you believe more will appear?[/i]
EK: It’s not a possibility. It’s a certainty.

notes.title: QANGA UPDATE - Patch Notes v0.0.13a
notes.notes:
We’re excited to bring you the latest update for Qanga, packed with new features, improvements, and bug fixes to enhance your experience. Read on to discover the latest changes that will make your journey even more immersive!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png[/img]

[h2]🚀 NEW FEATURES 🚀[/h2]

[h3]Pathfinding[/h3]

The basic pathfinding system of Unreal Engine was not suitable for Qanga for several reasons. First, it doesn't allow for rotations in all directions, making it unusable in a spherical world like a planet. 

Additionally, it is limited to paths on the ground, whereas we needed three types of pathfinding: on the ground, on specific surfaces for the Sanglines, and in the air for flying AI. Therefore, we developed a custom pathfinding system, fully tailored in-house, specifically designed to meet our needs. To date, this system is in alpha and is not yet final.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/2b82ebb7fb5addf69197b51710fce435e0d8f9b0.png[/img]
This system, fully multithreaded, generates a grid in real time in the form of an octree within a uniform cube and allows direct sampling of a planet's surface. This enables us to create any location on the planet on demand. Moreover, the system allows the generation of high-resolution grids for specific areas of the universe, providing increased precision where needed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/1f450cfe4ede81739761e3f8d02937839b982763.png[/img]
However, there are still many improvements to be made, such as a better distance field system, surface and ground angle management, a multi-level hierarchical grid to cover large areas, support for EQS searches in the grid, pathfinding options adapted to agent size, zone tagging with specific definitions, jump zone detection, real-time updating of movable zones, collision management for multiple paths, non-uniform octree grids, and deferred path calculations. Many optimizations are also coming.

[previewyoutube=gJIA5HYF7QQ;full][/previewyoutube]
The entire system works fully multithreaded, ensuring smooth handling of complex calculations in parallel, and it has been designed without using any external libraries, giving us full control over the tool's customization.

Here's an example of two NPCs walking: 

[previewyoutube=jHzvM2x2ZGw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]HOTAS Support[/h3]

HOTAS support has been added in this update. Although the feature is still in the testing phase, it is fully functional. We’ve integrated a raw input plugin from the engine, allowing for extensive control customization, including up to 24 custom axis. Players can adjust scaling, remapping zones, and deadzones for full analog control via the advanced settings for each axis.

We’ve also ensured that support for standard gamepads is maintained, with compatibility for gamepad analog sticks.

However, due to the variety of controller types, we rely on your feedback to help us refine this feature and ensure it works optimally across a wide range of devices.

[h3]Vehicle Customization[/h3]

The vehicle customization window has been improved. You will also have more color options available (28 + 1 default now).

[previewyoutube=VCk5YvBRaLk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]New locations[/h3]

ICLabs has opened a new lunar base. As usual, this location offers all the comfort needed for a well-deserved break. You will find private cabins for your stay, as well as all the amenities to relax. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/f9ae85f998a0baeb4b460434194dff3d23d0c67f.jpg[/img]
If you need supplies, the armory and medical service are available. And for those looking to unwind, our bar welcomes you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/1e641a0e0e9b0411c72b83a12617b99bb59f1fe8.jpg[/img]
Access the base using the command: /tp moona1.

In parallel, new opportunities are available in space. Mineable asteroids have been added near the ICLISPACE station and are now visible on the Starmap.


[h3]Statistics[/h3]

A new statistics system has been added for characters, allowing players to view counters based on their explorations, including kills, distances traveled, and exploration completed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/99d80e157be9e047a520ff85474aed5061d6cbae.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png[/img]

[h2]🛠 UI AND CONTROLS IMPROVEMENTS 🛠[/h2]

[list]
[*]Multiple fixes to the input system and UI
[*]Analog inputs support for joysticks and gamepad configuration
[*]Fixed view rotation in the vehicle editor
[*]Improved icons on the star map for testing: to simplify, when looking at the star map, only essential elements like vendors are visible by default. To see other things like contracts, you need to scan, and the icon will appear. To avoid a flood of icons, they have been split between those visible by default and those requiring scanning.
[*]General improvement of English localization.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png[/img]

[h2]🔧 BUG FIXES AND IMPROVEMENTS 🔧[/h2]

[list]
[*]Fixed some issues with the item system to avoid overload on save
[*]Multiple fixes and improvements to the contract system for better functionality at long distances
[*]Optimized collisions for the Single Storm. The problem still persists on certain objects and will be resolved shortly.
[*]Fixed the lighting of the passenger headlight
[*]Fixed buttons on the Single Storm
[*]Multiple adjustments and improvements to the StarMap
[*]Increased docking speed for Warp
[*]Corrected the scanner zone size
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png[/img]

Thank you for your continued support and feedback as we work to make Qanga even better. Stay tuned for future updates, and keep exploring the vast universe we've created. We look forward to seeing you in-game and on [url=https://discord.gg/qanga]our Discord server[/url]!

notes.title: Handbook for the Newly Activated Cyborg
notes.notes:
Citizen, your synchronization is in progress. You have just been activated as a Cyborg under the supervision of ICLabs Industries. The Earth you once knew is no more. Your mission: explore, survive, and thrive in this ruined world where every strategic decision and effort count to ensure your survival and rise.
This advanced technology, developed by ICLabs Industries, allows you to travel across Earth and space without the limitations of a human body. Synchronization transfers your mind into a freshly reconstructed Cyborg each time you return to life. The process is instantaneous, but beware—each death results in the loss of any unstored resources.

To maximize your efficiency from the moment of activation, this guide has been designed to provide you with the essential knowledge for your survival and progression. You will learn to master your synthetic body, understand available resources, pilot your first vehicles, and complete vital missions.
ICLabs assures you that all information contained here has been tested and approved. Now, it’s time to move. Your future starts now.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png[/img]

[h2]Matter[/h2]

Matter is essential for regenerating your Cyborg’s health. You can find it by exploring ruins, recycling useless objects, or as a mission reward. Store enough to avoid unpleasant surprises during your expeditions. It allows you to heal quickly when the situation becomes critical. You may also find Matter containers, which hold a large amount.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/99ad8f6ab1faf044843b9acf82c637c9d021922c.jpg[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png[/img]

[h2]The Drone[/h2]

Your Cyborg comes equipped with a drone, but it’s much more than just a companion. It offers a TPS (third-person view) while allowing you to switch to FPS (first-person view) for greater combat precision. However, the drone is not indestructible: if it’s shot down by an enemy, you’ll lose access to the TPS view and certain advanced functions. Take care of it. Fortunately, your Cyborg has a drone fabrication unit, so it will be quickly replaced if destroyed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/f34a74e1bfd0fbdd9ad8f35279c1ec12736d836d.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png[/img]

[h2]The Jetpack[/h2]

The jetpack is a valuable asset for exploring quickly and avoiding dangerous situations. It automatically recharges over time, allowing you to perform extended jumps or reach otherwise inaccessible areas. Managing its use wisely is crucial, as running out of energy at the wrong moment could leave you at the mercy of your enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/b57e337633ac0032d93eff5b36adf07078b4e7bf.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png[/img]

[h2]Phases[/h2]

By completing various activities in the game, your Cyborg can progress and gain XP levels. Each level grants you a skill point, which you can spend to enhance different abilities:
[list]
[*]Scanner: Increases range and accuracy.
[*]Regeneration: Speeds up your Cyborg's recovery.
[*]Weapon Damage: Boosts your firepower.
[*]Jetpack: Extends its usage time.
[*]Drone: Enhances its analysis and combat capabilities.
[*]Matter Storage: Allows you to carry more resources.
[/list]

XP is earned by exploring, completing missions, and eliminating threats. Prioritize your choices based on your playstyle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/a78c45e912cc0ebfab957ed6b98a696c85da47b9.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png[/img]

[h2]Checkpoints[/h2]

Checkpoints are essential for progressing smoothly. These stations save your position and allow you to respawn at the last activated point if your Cyborg is destroyed. Make sure to activate them regularly to avoid losing your progress.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/79416a54880a5fa78dfaddb123870bd20f08f88f.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png[/img]

[h2]Refuel Towers[/h2]

These outposts are much more than simple refueling stations. You will find:
[list]
[*]Armories: To upgrade your arsenal.
[*]Pawn Shops: To sell your findings for money.
[*]Infirmaries: To restore your health and buy Matter.[/list]
Refuel Towers also allow you to refuel your spaceship, an essential resource for your travels.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/f4ac07b85bd3f886c586eca6817b939ce1fabb6e.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png[/img]

[h2]The Scanner[/h2]

The integrated scanner is indispensable for your survival. It allows you to detect enemies, resources, and points of interest nearby. Use it frequently to avoid ambushes and uncover vital resources. Improving the scanner with skill points can extend its range and accuracy, making the difference between life and death in hostile zones.

It is certainly the tool that will be most useful to you in your exploration of the solar system, so don't hesitate to use and abuse it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png[/img]

[h2]Activites[/h2]

The world of QANGA offers various activities, rewarding you with money, Matter, and XP.

[list]
[*]Contracts: On Earth and beyond, numerous threats lurk, and it’s necessary to counter them quickly. These contracts focus on eliminating these dangers to make the world a bit safer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/24923ce2efe6e5255907f65f871ee81998ff382b.jpg[/img]
[*]Deliveries: They require less bloodshed but more precision. The terminals in Refuel Towers are filled with packages to transport. Less stress, but an equally important mission.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/e0972c54f6bc75044a344b63b47087ac28a3704d.jpg[/img]
[*]Missions: Missions in Qanga are as much about exploring new places as they are about overcoming challenges. Each contract sends you to specific locations with a clear objective: defend a supply shuttle against waves of enemies, infiltrate an abandoned base to extract sensitive data, or eliminate a threat before it becomes too great. The action is intense, and every fight demands precision and sharp reflexes.[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png[/img]

[h2]The Sanglines[/h2]

The Sanglines were born from a catastrophic mutation, unleashed when bacteria long dormant in glaciers resurfaced after their thaw. These creatures, halfway between organic and abomination, represent the most direct threat to Cyborgs exploring Earth. Their brute force and ability to move in packs make them formidable adversaries.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/1c02c18c85991325fff84738f4327be8b1b359aa.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/00bc8a415fd597b24351807cef9a2a7c2ee9cd1c.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png[/img]

[h2]Travel[/h2]

To move across Earth and beyond, you will have several means at your disposal. The first one you will discover is the tram system, a network of shuttles allowing you to travel from one Refuel Tower to another. Their use is free—make the most of it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/e74c46e99e3817dc4234a495dc0f7817ed78661b.jpg[/img]

After saving up some money, you’ll also be able to purchase a ground vehicle. Equipped with anti-grav thrusters, they offer a practical way to reach mission sites or travel across Earth’s surface quickly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/2d51c1a038ea81a8260e92e828b488cb218ce186.jpg[/img]

They may be more expensive, but spaceships are the most prized means of travel among Cyborgs. Your ship is almost like your second home. Whether it’s for crossing Earth at high speed or reaching nearby planets, it will be your most faithful companion.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/7b65a4d90c279f6ece8792435c29ae8c48d61f7c.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png[/img]

[h2]Yellow Wall[/h2]

Once you have your spaceship, come visit us at Yellow Wall. Located in Europe, right in the Atlantic, this city is humanity’s last great bastion. Climate catastrophes and the fight against the Sanglines have not spared it, but it still stands, against all odds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/06af908bee2fadb732e981329fc792549dbc160f.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png[/img]

[i]This is all you needed to know to start your adventure, Cyborg. There is still much to learn, but these are discoveries you will have to make on your own… or alongside other Cyborgs.[/i]

notes.title: QANGA UPDATE - Patch Notes v0.0.12
notes.notes:
Greetings, Cyborgs,

A new update is rolling out on QANGA, marking a crucial step forward as we introduce a significant expansion of content and new features. This is a preliminary update designed to enrich the gameplay experience ahead of a major upcoming update—the most substantial since the launch of Early Access. These additions are fully functional and will continue to be expanded in the coming weeks.

Little note: the version 0.0.11 has been tested internally. This is why the patch-notes have been updated from version 0.0.10 to 0.0.12.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png[/img]

[h2]🚀 NEW FEATURES 🚀[/h2]

[h3]Mining[/h3]
It is now possible to extract essential resources! The first available materials are Iron, Lithium, and Copper. While they will later be used in crafting, for now, they can be stored or sold.

A new tool for mining these resources is already available from your usual vendors.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/0154bbab97b4d6ece83baa55aa4da620c9a78fcd.gif[/img]

[h3]New Sanglines[/h3]
A new threat has emerged in the Sangline ecosystem. The Gazsac is an airborne predator that hunts from above and explodes on contact. Its unpredictable behavior makes it especially dangerous. More unique Sanglines will be introduced soon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/b76b1fcd0dfee6d91616b0d9dea821d60bff821d.png[/img]

[h3]Sanglines Spawners[/h3]
We don’t yet have concrete data on what triggered these appearances, but Sangline spawners have surfaced from underground. Approaching them is extremely dangerous, but those brave enough to destroy them can expect valuable rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/1b8e57cdfcc7d12177c09244a9f41153532fe169.jpg[/img]

[h3]New Missions[/h3]
🛢 [b]Refinery[/b]: A supply ship is en route to collect a valuable oil shipment, but the Sanglines won’t let this operation go unchallenged. You must defend the site and fend off increasingly aggressive waves of enemies. Strategy and coordination will be key to ensuring the survival of the ship and securing the delivery.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/ecd68b173426f3594126ae9212223628ccff8fda.jpg[/img]

🏢 [b]IC Labs Complex[/b]: An abandoned research facility holds critical data for the future of human technology. However, recovering it won’t be easy. You’ll have to infiltrate the complex, extract sensitive information, and survive relentless Sangline attacks as they fight to defend their claimed territory. Only the boldest and best-prepared will make it out alive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/7017646dc195ac7ec592ae8f9267a32f525f5f59.png[/img]

[h3]New Locations[/h3]
In addition to the Refinery and IC Labs Complex, you can now explore a farm, another refinery, and a weapons factory. Who knows what forgotten treasures might be hidden within?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/4c9db280284a9b79e7a2fe3e4b2a785b81b73e48.jpg[/img]

You can now customize your ship’s weaponry! Do you prefer the rapid-fire devastation of a machine gun, or the raw destructive power of missile launchers?
Additionally, you can equip a mining beam, allowing you to gather resources without ever leaving your pilot seat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png[/img]

[h2] ⚙️ PERFORMANCE OPTIMIZATIONS ⚙️[/h2]

[list]
[*]Multiple optimizations on AI behavior
[*]General optimization of processing times.
[/list]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png[/img]

notes.title: Your Feedbacks, our focus for the future
notes.notes:
[b]Greetings, Cyborgs,[/b]

Since the early access launch of QANGA, we’ve taken the time to collect and analyze each of your feedback points. Your input is invaluable, and today, we wanted to be fully transparent with you.

First of all, a huge thank you to everyone who has taken the time to play, share their thoughts, and support the project. We are a very small team, and your support has an enormous impact on our motivation and ability to grow QANGA.

Regarding your feedback, here are the major points we’ve identified:


[h2]Ship control[/h2]

Opinions are divided. Some of you love the current feel, while others find the controls too rigid. We’re working on finding the right balance to ensure the experience remains immersive without sacrificing maneuverability. Additionally, HOTAS/joystick support is highly requested, and we’re committed to implementing it in the future. Lastly, while not frequently mentioned, we’re also working on new ships to add to your fleet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png[/img]

[h2]Content variety[/h2]

Many of you pointed out a lack of diversity, both in terms of enemies and environments. Refuel Towers are often seen as too repetitive, and Yellow Wall, while praised for its design, feels too empty. We’re aware of these issues and already have plans to enrich the universe. For now, we can share that new environments are in the works, and a major effort is underway to introduce more Sanglines to expand the creature roster. And we shared recently  [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1648190/announcements/detail/523080695502865067]a little overview[/url] of what will come very soon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png[/img]

[h2]“Tech demo” impression[/h2]

Some players feel there’s a lack of depth in the content, making the game seem more like a showcase than a complete experience. We take this very seriously and are focused on adding more activities and features in upcoming updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png[/img]

[h2]Optimization[/h2]

Many reports have flagged performance issues, even on powerful setups. We’ve made some improvements recently and will continue working to make the experience smoother.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png[/img]

[h2]Demo[/h2]

A QANGA demo titled “Road to Yellow Wall” is available with no time limits. It was updated in early October 2024 and, while it gives a good sense of the full game, it lacks certain content. We’re planning an update for the demo soon to better reflect the full QANGA experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png[/img]

Of course, there’s still a lot of work to do. But what you’ve also made clear is that QANGA has a great potential. Your belief in our project drives us to push ourselves every day to make QANGA the game we all dream of playing.

For those who want to keep track of the project’s progress, we’ve made a roadmap available [url=https://mypremo.fr/app/b/a30d495a-e887-4d5a-9de2-6a13a3ca7484]here[/url]. It outlines what’s planned and what we’re currently working on. We’ll soon reorganize and update the roadmap to better reflect our priorities and make it clearer for you.

Lastly, if you’re enjoying your experience, please consider leaving a positive review on Steam. It helps us tremendously in growing the game’s visibility and supporting its continued development. And don't hesitate to join us on [url=https://discord.gg/qanga]Discord[/url] to share your love for QANGA!

Thank you again for your patience, passion, and support. Together, we’ll keep moving forward.

[i]The QANGA Team[/i]

notes.notes:
Greetings Cyborgs,

A new update is now available for QANGA, including bug fixes, improvements, the addition of melee weapons, assistance transport, and a special holiday-themed atmosphere!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/704a44fa5475304202d24fd9c8401a1182a5276f.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png[/img]

[h3]🗡️ MELEE WEAPONS 🪓[/h3]

Discover an entirely new range of melee weapons, designed for those who prefer close combat and the raw intensity of face-to-face encounters. Axes, pipes, knives, or even improvised tools, each weapon suits your style. Whether you're going for a frontal assault or a more tactical approach, these new weapons expand your battlefield options, adding an extra dose of dynamism to your fights. Get ready to strike with style and precision!

[list]
[*]Shovel

[*]Crowbar 
[*]Stun Baton

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/4f0dcfe8578510bb962f35e000175c1856bd2f91.png[/img]

Weapon stats are displayed in the inventory. For now, all weapons deal the same damage, but with your feedback, we’ll adjust their values to deliver a more balanced and cohesive gameplay experience!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png[/img]

[h3]🎄HOLIDAY SEASON🎄[/h3]

Just because Earth has endured numerous cataclysms and much of humanity was wiped out by the Sanglines doesn’t mean we can’t celebrate Christmas and other festivities!

Refuel Towers and Warp Stations have been decorated for the occasion, featuring Christmas trees and all sorts of gifts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/4d677f2616ec274cf1077f9833cfafa765bbe546.jpg[/img]

By the way, don’t forget to check the gifts—you never know what delightful surprises might be inside!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png[/img]

[h3]🚀 ASSISTANCE 🚨[/h3]

A new feature has been introduced to make your journey easier: Assistance. Now, you can call for transport anytime, anywhere. This space taxi will quickly pick you up and take you to the nearest Refuel Tower of your choice. Whether it’s after your ship has been destroyed or to avoid a long walk, Assistance ensures your adventure continues uninterrupted. Convenient and reliable, this service is your best ally in tough situations!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png[/img]

[h3]⚙️ SHADOW IMPROVEMENTS ⚙️[/h3]

Significant work has been done to enhance shadow rendering, improving visual quality without impacting performance, even on the lowest settings. Shadows are now permanently enabled, including in "low" mode, providing a more immersive experience in the world of QANGA. Using a new shadow baking technique, each light source generates a pre-calculated specific texture that projects detailed shadows, even over long distances. This optimization also eliminates the white haze that was previously visible on objects illuminated by distant lights.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png[/img]

The team has made significant improvements to spaceships to deliver a smoother and more immersive experience. Speed control can now be adjusted directly via the mouse wheel and is always displayed on-screen, with a quick toggle option using the B key. This system automatically deactivates during braking while allowing manual acceleration at any time for greater flexibility. Additionally, the boost feature has been enhanced to deliver more power and now operates in a "hold to boost" mode, making maneuvers more dynamic. Finally, spaceship piloting has been refined, with adjustable atmospheric control parameters available in the admin settings under Spacecraft | MinAtmosphereAlpha.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png[/img]

[*]Adjusted jetpack controls to allow rolling while hovering or flying fast in space (requires keybind reset).  
[*]Animal AI adjustments.

[*]Speed Control: Now adjustable via the mouse wheel and always displayed on-screen. It can be toggled on or off using the B key, automatically deactivates during braking, and allows manual acceleration override.
[*]Boost: Enhanced with increased power and now operates in a "hold to boost" mode for greater responsiveness.
[*]Spacecraft Controls: Improved for better precision, with customizable settings available in the admin parameters under Spacecraft | MinAtmosphereAlpha.
[*]Quick access (stairs) is now available to reach the upper levels of warp stations.

notes.title: Discover QANGA for free
notes.notes:
If you’re wondering if QANGA is the right game for you or if your PC can handle the universe we’ve created, we’ve got great news: the free demo is here to help! It lets you try the game with no commitment, explore a bit of our world, and check if everything runs smoothly on your setup. Let us tell you more about it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png[/img]

QANGA is, above all, a spatial journey, a post-apocalyptic adventure where you play as a Cyborg. The game takes you into a solar system recreated at a 1:2 scale, offering total freedom to fly between planets, land, build, explore… But that’s for the full version. The demo provides a solid introduction to give you a taste of what’s to come.

In this demo, you’ll be able to land your ship on Earth and the Moon. Yes, just those two for now, but trust us, there’s plenty to do! On Earth, you’ll discover devastated zones and a few surprises to explore. The Moon, on the other hand, offers a completely different environment with its own set of challenges.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/8c424941f9f2aa34b3d127d1392dee77328d7a4a.jpg[/img]

What about the other planets? They’re not accessible in the demo, but you’ll see them from your cockpit. It’s a glimpse into the vast universe we’ve built.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png[/img]

We know a lot of players are curious about the game’s performance before jumping in. That’s perfectly understandable—QANGA is an ambitious game with rich graphics and a deep universe. The demo is specifically designed to answer these questions. With just a few clicks, you’ll find out if the game runs well on your machine, tweak the graphics settings, and ensure a smooth experience.

It’s also a great way to get a feel for the gameplay and atmosphere without making a commitment. Take your time to explore, and if you like it, you’ll already know it works well on your PC.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png[/img]

The demo is single-player only, and that’s intentional. No multiplayer, no PvP—just you and the universe. It’s a chance to take things slow, explore at your own pace, and focus on the essentials: flying, exploring, and managing your resources. You can test it all without any pressure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/0a461e7f4bbe825e0e65e7991051fde29711008c.jpg[/img]

In the full version, multiplayer is available for those who enjoy sharing the adventure or taking on PvP challenges. But here, we wanted to offer you a more personal moment to discover the game’s core features.

One small note: the demo is based on an earlier version of the game. Since its early access launch, we’ve added content, made adjustments, and improved the overall experience. What you’ll see in the demo is just a preview. If you already enjoy this version, just wait until you see what we’ve enhanced in the full game!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png[/img]

It’s like flipping through a book before buying it—you get a taste, and it leaves you wanting more.

So, what are you waiting for? Download the free demo on Steam, dive into the universe of QANGA, and let the adventure pull you in. If this first experience wins you over, why not upgrade to the full version?

Purchasing the game also supports our small team, who are pouring their hearts into this project. You can buy it directly on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1648190/QANGA/]Steam[/url], or through [url=https://qanga.iolacorp.com/shop]our official store here[/url]. By purchasing through our store, you’ll also receive exclusive bonuses to enhance your experience!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png[/img]

[i]We hope you’ll be captivated. The universe of QANGA is waiting for you. Ready to take off?[/i]

notes.title: QANGA needs your talents
notes.notes:
Hi Cyborgs,

Today, we have something special for you: the chance to be part of QANGA’s journey by contributing to its localization. Yes, you read that right! You can help QANGA speak your language (and maybe even your neighbor's).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/a4f152ef4818de90b86796aa382fbd1715b23249.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png[/img]

[h3]Why localization matters[/h3]

QANGA is a vast game, packed with adventures and discoveries. To make sure everyone can fully enjoy the experience, every text, menu, and dialogue needs to be available in as many languages as possible. Playing in your native language makes immersion so much more enjoyable.

But here’s the thing: translating a game of this scale takes time, resources… and a helping hand from the community!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png[/img]

[h3]How you can help[/h3]

This is where Localizor comes in—a fantastic tool that lets passionate players directly contribute to the translation of the games they love. You don’t need to be a professional translator: if you’re confident in a language and want to help out, Localizor is here for you.

Here’s how you can participate:
[list]
[*][b]Head to [url=https://www.localizor.com/qanga]QANGA’s Localizor page[/url].[/b] [i]Once there, you’ll see all the available languages and the ones that could use some help.[/i]
[*][b]Create a Localizor account.[/b] [i]It’s quick, easy, and free. A few clicks and you’re ready to go.[/i]
[*][b]Choose a language you’re fluent in.[/b] [i]Whether it’s French, English, Spanish, or even less common languages, your help is invaluable![/i]
[*][b]Start translating.[/b] [i]Localizor’s interface is intuitive. You’ll see phrases or words from the game that need translation, and you can submit your suggestions.[/i][/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/b4c483a7aa8bb6dc3c837ae008598ca7d7964d10.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png[/img]

[h3]A community-driven adventure[/h3]

Contributing to the localization is also a way to become part of QANGA’s history. You’re directly helping make the game more accessible and inclusive. Who knows? Your translation of a single phrase might even become iconic in the community!

We carefully monitor all contributions and make sure the best suggestions get validated. If you have any questions, feel free to reach out to us on [url=https://discord.gg/qanga]Discord[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png[/img]

[h3]Join us now![/h3]

Ready to take on the challenge? Whether you’re a language expert or just curious to give it a try, every little contribution helps. Head over to Localizor and help bring QANGA to life in new languages.

Thank you in advance for your enthusiasm and invaluable help. Together, we can make QANGA a truly universal adventure!

[i]See you soon in the world of QANGA, and good luck with your translations! 🚀[/i]

For 250 years, first-generation weapons have served with honor, but the era of change is here. At ICLabs, we are proud to unveil a revolutionary arsenal, designed specifically for you, Cyborgs: more powerful, more precise, and perfectly tailored to meet your needs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/e06d0e83dda10897f8c957d34aa5042894b39123.png[/img]

Each weapon in this collection has been meticulously re-engineered to tackle modern challenges. More than just an upgrade, it's a true rebirth of the models that have stood the test of time. Here's what awaits:

[h3][b]The classics, perfected:[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*]Nash Pistol – Your trusted ally for quick and precise defense.
[*]Nash SMG – Ideal for close-quarters combat, this submachine gun offers enhanced stability and precision, even in prolonged bursts.
[*]Nash Shotgun – The ultimate close-range weapon. New cartridges provide tighter spreads for maximized damage.
[*]Nash Assault Rifle – A versatile classic, refined to excel in any combat situation.
[*]Nash Machine Gun – The quintessential heavy weapon, now equipped with an upgraded cooling system for extended firepower.
[*]Nash Sniper – Surgical precision paired with a new optical system to dominate long-range battlefields.[/list]

[h3][b]The newcomers, ready to obliterate:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Nash Grenade Launcher – Perfect for blasting through obstacles, clearing enemy clusters, or opening new pathways.
[*]Nash Rocket Launcher – Unmatched brute force for neutralizing massive threats or demolishing enemy structures in a single shot.[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/324b8fc4f95b6e5b951adb2f44d6c3f0e5a38fd5.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/607e11fc16a6a618b2cd3e5c37a4d8472e9369e7.png[/img]

[h3]Say goodbye to the past... but not forever![/h3]

First-generation weapons, those faithful companions that shaped Cyborg history, are no longer available for purchase at Refuel Towers. But fear not: collectors and relic enthusiasts can still discover them during exploration or trade for them on the market. And if you already own one of these legends, rest assured—it remains by your side, ready to honor your legacy on the battlefield.

At ICLabs, we know survival depends on precise and immediate information. That’s why we’ve upgraded the Cyborg Management Interface v2. Now, every equipped weapon comes with an intuitive, detailed display accessible at a glance (for Cyborgs using tactile or connected interfaces).

These features include:

[list]
[*]Weapon stats: damage, rate of fire, magazine capacity.
[*]Ammunition type.
[/list]

This enhancement ensures better planning and faster reactions in critical moments. Equipped Cyborgs will never be caught off guard.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/e8d799bddf9869c1313705bbe931821fa57bf24f.png[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/607e11fc16a6a618b2cd3e5c37a4d8472e9369e7.png[/img]


Whether you're facing Sanglines or tackling the universe's toughest challenges, our new weapons will always give you the decisive edge.

Eager to try these marvels? Good news: they're available now at your nearest store. A simple update is all it takes to secure the best in weaponry. Embrace excellence—choose ICLabs. Because your survival is our priority. You deserve the best to conquer the unknown.

What are you waiting for? Take the next step in technology today.

ICLabs – Innovation for All

notes.title: QANGA UPDATE - Patch Notes v0.0.7a
notes.notes:
Dear players,

We are pleased to present the [b]v0.0.7a[/b] update for [b]QANGA[/b].  
This version brings several major improvements, new features, and bug fixes.  

[h2]🆕 New Features 🆕[/h2]

[h3]🚀 FreeWarp on Spaceships[/h3]  
[list]  
    [*][b]FreeWarp Usage:[/b] You can now use FreeWarp to navigate more quickly and precisely over short distances around a planet. However, FreeWarp cannot be used in atmospheres and will recharge over time after usage. In the future, we will further integrate this feature into the gameplay.  
[/list]  

[h3]🛠 Classic "Warp" Becomes "SpaceJump"[/h3]  
[list]  
    [*][b]Warp Replacement:[/b] We have replaced the traditional Warp with "SpaceJump." This change will add a new layer of depth to navigation mechanics.  
[/list]  

[h3]🎁 New Item Distribution System in the World[/h3]  
[list]  
    [*][b]Item Placement on Surfaces:[/b] You'll notice that item distribution in various locations has changed. We have developed a more logical distribution system compared to previous versions, ensuring that the placement of items in their environment is more coherent and less repetitive.  
[/list]  

[h3]☁️ Volumetric Clouds[/h3]  
[list]  
    [*][b]Improved Clouds:[/b] We have implemented a new, more optimized and realistic cloud system. While we plan to work on dynamic weather systems on planetary surfaces in the future, these new clouds will be your companions for several updates until the dynamic weather system is ready.  
[/list]  

[h3]🏔 Everest Region[/h3]  
[list]  
    [*][b]Realistic Everest Heights:[/b] We have added the Everest region in a more realistic manner. You can now climb Everest at accurate altitudes. This fix also impacts all terrain heights on Earth, making them more realistic in-game.  
[/list]  

[h3]🪨 Saturn's Asteroid Rings[/h3]  
[list]  
    [*][b]Physicalized Asteroids:[/b] We have made every asteroid in Saturn's rings physical, allowing you to land on them and build your station. Note that the gravity on these asteroids is too weak to naturally pull you toward their surface. We will improve asteroid distribution and gravity interaction in future updates.  
[/list]  

[h2]🛠 Bug Fixes and Improvements 🛠[/h2]  

[h3]🌍 Terrain Rendering[/h3]  
[list]  
    [*][b]Ice Biome:[/b] We have reworked the icy zones on Earth to enhance their appearance and realism.  
    [*][b]Fixes:[/b] Some rocks that were floating in the air and had visible mesh seams have been resolved.  
[/list]  

[h3]🪐 Added a SpaceJump for Mercury[/h3]  
[list]  
    [*][b]Mercury SpaceJump:[/b] You now have the option to jump to Mercury. Please note that the surface still requires significant reworking.  
[/list]  

[h3]🛡️ Other Fixes[/h3]  
[list]  
    [*][b]Fixed numerous issues reported in the Discord report channel:[/b] Thanks to all of you for your feedback and help in improving the game.  
[/list]  

We hope you enjoy these new features and fixes! Thank you for your continued support and valuable feedback. Don't forget to report any bugs or issues on our Discord.  

See you soon in the universe of [b]QANGA[/b]!

[b]The QANGA Team[/b] 🌌

[*][b]Recompute of Global Reflections:[/b] Universe reflections have been recalculated for a more realistic rendering.[/*]

[*][b]Added Northern Lights and Airglow:[/b] Northern lights and the "Airglow" effect have been added to Earth's atmosphere for enhanced visual immersion.[/*]

[*][b]ICLI SPACE Collision Fixes:[/b] Collision issues within the ICLI SPACE station have been resolved. (don't go with singleStorm = 2 fps)[/*]

[*][b]MiddleTower Complex Improvements at YellowWallCity:[/b] Level design improvements and collision fixes have been made to this area.[/*]

[*][b]DS Session Creation Fixes:[/b] Fixed arguments during session creation for dedicated servers.[/*]

[*][b]FR Server Backup Setup:[/b] Server backup system has been implemented for versioning the French server's data.[/*]

    [*][b]Guard Aim Adjustments:[/b] Improved guard aiming but requires further work.[/*]
[/list]
[h3]Global Storage System:[/h3]
[list]
    [*][b]Storage on Refuel:[/b] Each refueltower has its own global storage. If you store an item at the finister refueltower, you can access it anywhere. [/*]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/37ddb57a759344b0eff572bac7a2ddc50e138d3b.png[/img]
[h3]Tutorial Level Procedure:[/h3]
[list]
    [*][b]Performance Optimization:[/b] Significantly improved performance, with the tutorial now placed in a separate level.[/*]
    [*][b]Replayability:[/b] Access the tutorial level from the game menu to relearn game functions.[/*]
    [*][b]Future Improvements:[/b] The tutorial model allows for creating more learning rooms. Currently, only one sub-tutorial is accessible (Passenger ship driving).[/*]
[/list]
[h3]Known Issues:[/h3]
[list]
    [*][b]Lumen Distance Origin:[/b] Lumen currently does not support long distances, creating global illumination artifacts far from the world origin. This issue will be fixed in future Unreal Engine updates.[/*]
    [*][b]Texture Artifact Triangle:[/b] Some materials may display triangular reflection artifacts at great distances. This issue will be resolved in future updates.[/*]
    [*][b]Contract Failures:[/b] Some contracts fail immediately upon acceptance. This issue is under investigation.[/*]
    [*][b]Vehicle Owner Replication:[/b] Rarely, the position of your vehicle is not correctly replicated to friends. We are investigating this issue.[/*]
    [*][b]VO-IP Delay:[/b] Audio packets may experience delays. This issue is under investigation.[/*]
    [*][b]BackPack Inconsistency:[/b] The current logic is based on slots. We plan to rework the inventory system to base it on weight.[/*]
[/list]


We still have many surprises in store, but we prefer to let you discover them yourself. Your feedback is crucial, so please share your impressions on our Steam community or here on Discord.
We invite you to join the discord, the community is here to help you understand the game.

See you soon in the world of QANGA!


[b]The QANGA Team[/b]

notes.title: QANGA DEMO Update: Enhancements and Fixes
notes.notes:
[h2]Major QANGA Update - Improvements Based on Your Feedback[/h2]

[b]We're excited to announce that a significant update, based on your valuable feedback! After carefully reviewing your comments and watching gameplay videos on YouTube, we've crafted enhancements to enrich your gaming experience.[/b]

[b]New Features and Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*]Immediate Access to Gameplay: The introduction sequence has been removed for a direct immersion into the world of QANGA.
[*]Gender Choice at Startup: Players can choose their gender right from the start and embark on their adventure as a cyborg.
[*]Access to Flying Vehicles from the Beginning: Quick access to flying vehicles in the starting area for an enhanced traversal experience.
[/list]

[b]Tutorial and Gameplay:[/b]
Improved Tutorial: Enhanced understanding of game mechanics with the introduction of:
[list]
[*]Item Recycling: Convert items into "matter" energy.
[*]Third-Person Drone Camera: Visible and destructible by other players.
[*]Phases: Allocate skill points to weapons and cyborg modules.
[*]Cyborg Modules: For example, jetpack improvement for fast flying.
[*]Discovery Points: Enhanced exploration with discovery terminals.
[/list]

[b]User Interface and Navigation:[/b]
[list]
[*]Removal of On-Screen Trackers: Trackers are now integrated into the StarMap for a cleaner interface.
[*]Clarity of On-Screen Trackers: Unique color system for easy identification of different elements (ReselleMachine, Matter distributor, etc.).
[/list]

[b]Graphical Optimization:[/b]
[list]
[*]Visual Improvements: Optimizations for PoleLights, Volumetric Clouds, and Foliage Mesh for better graphical performance.
[*]PostProcess Enhancement: More realistic lens flare effects.
[/list]

[b]Global Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Visibility of Phases on Objects: Correction of phase visibility.
[*]Level Loading: Resolution of level streaming issues.
[*]Elevator Button Operation: Fix for buttons getting stuck.
[*]Discovery Terminal XP Adjustments: Tweaks for better balance.
[*]Vehicle Input Feedback: Improved feedback for vehicle controls.
[/list]

In light of these changes, we hope you will also perceive the true sandbox nature of the game. Our vision for QANGA has always been to provide a vast, open-ended experience where creativity and exploration are paramount. 

Stay connected for upcoming updates, and please feel free to keep sharing your experiences and suggestions.

[url=https://discord.gg/qanga]Server Discord[/url] 

Thank you for being part of this exciting adventure.
